verdict.rationale: Data export in open formats is a fair question for a government company-registry portal where users file and hold records, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, and nothing on either site was fetched. That says nothing about whether users can export their data, so there is no evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
